levels.0: origin: play_type in {punt, field_goal, run, pass}
levels.1: also include play_type == 'no_play' rows classified by provider flags (see manifest S3b)
include play_type in {qb_kneel, qb_spike} with risk_taking = 0

levels.0: origin: nested (1 for every same-conference opponent, including same-division)
levels.1: exclusive (1 only for same-conference opponents outside the division)
home_field = 0 for both teams when games.location == 'Neutral'

levels.0: origin: conditional logit (exact conditional likelihood) grouped by offensive team, season dummies as regressors
levels.1: unconditional logit by ML with offensive-team dummies and season dummies
levels.2: conditional logit grouped by offensive team x season, no season dummies

marginal_effect_variants.ME0: origin: analytic derivative of p = invlogit(xb) with group effect set to 0 (no intercept), regressors other than the performance terms at estimation-sample means; at d = 0 use the below branch (indicator = 1)
marginal_effect_variants.U9a: uncertain: as ME0 but p averaged over the estimated team effects from the U7=1 unconditional fit (mean over teams of the derivative at each team's intercept), computed from the U7=1 fit with the same sample
marginal_effect_variants.U9b: uncertain: finite difference p(d+1) - p(d) instead of the derivative, otherwise as ME0
marginal_effect_variants.U10a: uncertain: at d = 0 use the above branch (indicator = 0, slope of the above piece)
marginal_effect_variants.N3: non-equivalent: average marginal effect over the estimation sample (each observation's own regressors, d and minutes replaced by the evaluation values), group effect 0

non_equivalent_runs.N1: random-effects logit by offensive team (normal random intercept, ML, adaptive quadrature or Laplace with stated settings), season dummies, origin sample, M1-M3
non_equivalent_runs.N2: replace minutes_remaining everywhere (main effect and the three interactions) by quarters_remaining = 5 - qtr; origin otherwise; M1-M3
non_equivalent_runs.N4: cluster-robust SE by offensive team (32 clusters) for the origin fits, reported as an inference alternative

algebraic_checks.K1: M3 with elapsed minutes (60 - minutes_remaining) in place of minutes_remaining in the main effect and the interactions: log-likelihood must equal the origin M3 log-likelihood
algebraic_checks.K2: M2 with home_field complemented (1 - home_field): log-likelihood must equal the origin M2 log-likelihood and the coefficient must change sign only

unavailable.spread_based_reference_point: construction not documented (lookback, reset rule); not executed
unavailable.field_goal_range_submodels: range cutoff and treatment of the third choice not documented; not executed

compute_order: 1 origin M1, M2, M3 (+ ME0, U9a, U9b, U10a, N3 for M2/M3; benchmark inference; tests)
2 individual deviations: each non-origin level of U1..U7 alone (M1-M3), U8=1 (M1 only); ME0 for M2/M3
3 full crossing U1 x U2 x U3 x U4 x U5 x U6 x U7 (2^6 x 3 = 192 combinations) for M1, M2, M3 with U8=0; ME0 for M2/M3; steps 1-2 combinations reappear and are flagged duplicate_of
benchmark_inference: cluster-robust sandwich by game_id (CR1 small-sample factor G/(G-1) x (N-1)/(N-K)) computed on every U7=1 (unconditional dummy-variable logit) fit, for coefficients and, by the delta method, for marginal effects. For U7=0 and U7=2 fits the benchmark columns are left empty; the scorer pairs them with the U7=1 fit sharing all other levels. N4 uses the same construction clustered by offensive team.
